entry.title: Cindy Holscher wins in Kansas, holding governor's office for Democrats
entry.summary: Holscher, a state senator, overcame a more well-known Republican who had Trump's endorsement in the state that has gone to the GOP in most other statewide races.

entry.title: What's a Honey Trap? The spy tactic that helped topple Jensen Huang
entry.summary: Jensen Huang, CEO of Nvidia, the leading AI chipmaker, resigned after admitting an extramarital affair with a woman the U.S. says is a Chinese spy. This espionage tactic is known as a honey trap.

entry.title: Search and rescue at site of collapsed New York City apartment building
entry.summary: First responders are still searching through the rubble of a three story apartment building that collapsed in Brooklyn on Wednesday, looking for any possible survivors.

entry.title: 'Punch in the gut': Homes sales fall to their lowest in 16 years
entry.summary: Existing homes sales in October declined 8.8% from a year earlier, according to the National Association of Realtors.

entry.title: Casualties continue to rise after Brooklyn building collapses
entry.summary: First responders continue to search for survivors after a building in Brooklyn collapsed, leaving at least eight dead and dozens injured.

entry.title: Democrats want to stop Trump's arch, golf course and more. What are their options?
entry.summary: As Trump's arch and other projects make their way through the courts, many critics are looking to Congress to stop them. Democrats have a few tools, including funding and oversight.

entry.title: Crews search for survivors after deadly Brooklyn building collapse
entry.summary: A three-story apartment building in Brooklyn collapsed, killing at least eight people and injuring two dozen others.

entry.title: Kennedy Center plans Ticketmaster switch, raising conflict of interest concerns
entry.summary: The Kennedy Center's former president Richard Grenell was a paid board member of Ticketmaster's parent company at the same time the two parties were negotiating.

entry.title: At least 23 states considered laws governing ICE and schools this year
entry.summary: When ICE agents show up at a school, educators rely on a patchwork of policies to know what to do. This year, many state legislatures tried to update those policies.
